dek: The Acting Commissioner for Digital Policy, Mr Daniel Cheung, attended the Awards Presentation Ceremony of the Hong Kong/Shanghai Co-operation Open Data Challenge (HSODC) 2026 in Shanghai today (August 25) as a Grand Award judge and extended his congratulations to the Hong Kong teams for winning three awards.
